GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-08-21T12:48:18Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Parallel select with group executes one query at the time
Description: **Env:**
`ClickHouse server version 19.13.1.11 (official build)` inside docker with default config.

**Problem:**
we are testing ClickHouse for our workload which includes many queries like this at the same time:
```
SELECT
       idxid,
       count(*) total,
       toInt8(avg(age)) age,
       countIf(liveness, equals(liveness, 2)) y1,
       countIf(liveness, equals(liveness, 1)) y2,
       countIf(liveness, equals(liveness, 3)) y3,
       countIf(result, equals(result, 5)) x1,
       countIf(result, equals(result, 3)) x2,
       countIf(result, equals(result, 7)) x3,
       countIf(result, equals(result, 4)) x4
FROM xxx.YYY
WHERE
      idxid == '...'
GROUP BY idxid;
```
Table creation:
```
CREATE TABLE xxx.YYY (
    id UInt64,
    group_id UInt64,
    idxid UUID,
    created DateTime,
    age UInt8,
    sex UInt8,
    ...
)
ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY (toYYYYMM(created), group_id)
ORDER BY (group_id, idxid);
```
Everything is fine with single request at the time:
```
root@893d4cfd0397:/# clickhouse-benchmark -i 1 < query.txt

Queries executed: 1.

QPS: 0.844, RPS: 15200054.808, MiB/s: 289.899, result RPS: 0.844, result MiB/s: 0.000.

```
Things become strange, when we are sending multiple requests at the same time^
```
oot@893d4cfd0397:/# clickhouse-benchmark -c 10 -i 10 < query.txt
Loaded 1 queries.

Queries executed: 10.

QPS: 0.969, RPS: 17444320.466, MiB/s: 332.702, result RPS: 0.969, result MiB/s: 0.000.
0.000% 9.813 sec.
10.000% 9.850 sec.
20.000% 9.953 sec.
30.000% 9.983 sec.

90.000% 10.172 sec.

99.900% 10.208 sec.
99.990% 10.208 sec.
```
Looks like there is some kind of a lock, which does not allow to execute multiple `select`s on the same data in parallel. Is there a workaround or some settings we can change to allow parallel execution of queries? Thanks!
